여러분 언제나 즐겁고 행복한 하루 보내세요 :D

I wanted this channel to be where I make and freely upload videos that I enjoyed and share with others. However, as I saw myself getting discouraged from all of the negativity, I realized that I couldn’t keep this channel for a long period of time. 
This could eventually be something that I could look back to my early days and reminiscent on or something that I continue doing in the future but as of right now, I think my happiness should come first. 
Thus, I wanted to make a way to restore my true self and my way was the limitation of the comments.
I hope everyone could understand where I am coming from, and be patient with me in my decision so that I could produce more videos happily in my own unique way.
Thank you for reading this long comment and I truly hope that my sincerity has been delivered.
As Always, I hope everyone is having a happy day :D 

As of now, I am happy with this new way.
